feeds.title: Emma Jewell Crafts Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Emma Jewell crafts blog, find craft and DIY tutorials, tips, and more. Hey! I am Emma, I own and run the Emma Jewell Crafts Blog. This blog is the place where I share all my creative projects. I am starting a craft revolution to make crafts sassy and cool.

feeds.title: Crafting in the Rain » Cricut
feeds.description: A creative blog featuring Cricut crafts, holiday projects, and ideas. Hi, I'm Stephanie, welcome to Crafting in the Rain where I've been blogging about crafty life. I use this blog as a way to document and share all my projects.

feeds.title: Extraordinary Chaos » Cricut
feeds.description: Welcome to my Crafting and Cricut Uk Crafting section and check out my posts and Tutorials. I'm Sarah, I am an obsessed UK Cricut Craft Blogger. At Extraordinary Chaos, I will share about family life, and my love for travel, craft, food, and theatre.

feeds.title: Sweet Red Poppy » Cricut
feeds.description: Enjoy the top Cricut blog with hundreds of free Cricut blog posts, videos, & tutorial projects to learn your Cricut machine. Welcome! I'm Kim, the founder, and CEO of Sweet Red Poppy. Here on the SRP blog, you will learn all about your sewing, serger, and Cricut machines. My goal is to inspire you to make, sew, or craft something new

feeds.title: Jennifer Maker
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Jennifer, the crafty writer behind JenniferMaker. I inspire you to make crafts and decorate your home. I'm always looking for something new and amazing things you can create. Find my tutorials for DIY adventures and reconnect with your creativity.

feeds.title: Hey Let's Make Stuff
feeds.description: Hey, I'm Cori, the owner and Creative Director of Hey, Let's Make Stuff. My blog is full of things to help you create a creative life you love, involving easy crafts, fun printables, SVG files for cutting on your Cricut, DIY home and decor ideas, and so much more.

feeds.title: Shawn Mosch Blog
feeds.description: Shawn Mosch A Cricut Design Space instructor who has created this Cricut Design Space for learning to use your Cricut. Shawn helps Cricut owners to understand the Cricut Design Space so that they can create amazing projects. She has created documents, tutorials, videos, and classes that can help anyone learn the steps.

feeds.title: Cricut Blog
feeds.description: Visit the Cricut Inspiration blog to find news, tips, and inspiration for crafts, DIY, organization, home decor, and other creative projects. Cricut is the leader in DIY crafting technology. Its popular electronic cutting systems help design and personalize almost anything like cards, apparel, everyday items, and so much more.

feeds.title: Cutting for Business
feeds.description: Cutting for Business is the original and largest website carrying a lot of information to help you start or grow your Silhouette or Cricut business. The website is dedicated to assisting with Silhouette Portrait, Cameo, Curio, Mint or Cricut Explore, Maker, or Joy along with social media tips and many unique ways.

feeds.title: Crafting Spree Blog
feeds.description: Connect with your Cricut community today with the Crafting Spree blog. Welcome to Crafting Spree, we're the one-stop shop for any and all things Cricut. Crafting Spree provides you with time-saving hacks and nearly endless sales to step-by-step tutorials & more.

feeds.title: Better Life Blog
feeds.description: Read more about Cricut and Silhouette Crafting, also get tutorials and SVG Files on Better Life Blog. Welcome! I am Nancy, an entrepreneur, a designer, and a creator of things. I run this amazing blog where we have fun with new projects, cut files, and many more crafting tutorials.

feeds.title: Weekend Craft » Cricut
feeds.description: Whether it be crafts, DIY, home decor, or crafting with your Cricut, Weekend Craft will brief you on everything. Hello! I'm Michelle, I started crafting more and more which is how Weekend Craft was born. You can find hear anything from making wreaths to creating cut files for graphic tees, making pallet signs to refinishing furniture.

feeds.title: So Fontsy blog » Cricut Tutorials
feeds.description: So Fontsy has an always-growing library of free tutorials for Cricut beginners, Silhouette newbies, and more. Learn how to use SVGs, and install fonts at the So Fontsy blog. It is your one-stop craft marketplace for commercial use fonts & SVG designs for Silhouette CAMEO, Cricut & Scan N Cut, and other die-cut machines.

feeds.title: Bitten by the Bug 2 Blog
feeds.description: BBTB2 is a twice-a-month Cricut challenge blog for paper crafts such as cards, scrapbooks, vinyl projects, or whatever you can make with your Cricut. Bitten by the Bug encourages Cricut users to grow their creativity.

feeds.title: Vinyl Cutting Machines
feeds.description: Vinyl Cutting Machines reviews the best vinyl cutters. We spotlight the latest machines from Cricut, Silhouette, Sizzix & more. It's one of the most interesting emerging craft markets. If you're planning to run a craft business with your cutter, Vinyl Cutting will be a complete guide for you.
